name: Adjoint Beer-Lambert Marching
definition: A method to compute the gradient of the Beer-Lambert line integral with respect to pose parameters in a single forward-like pass, avoiding the storage or recomputation of per-iteration state required by naive reverse-mode differentiation of the marching loop.
summary: Adjoint Beer-Lambert Marching computes pose gradients in a single pass, avoiding per-iteration state storage and offering a significant speedup over naive reverse-mode differentiation.
